comment: F6.05: the Build Settings platforms. Console knowledge lives here as data, not in tools/pipeline code (tools/check_editor_core.sh). flow: 'module' = a TargetModule of editor/targets does validate/compile/package/launch; 'cmake' = the pipeline configures and builds the player with a CMake preset; 'gradle' = tools/android. package.kind: 'folder' (exe + pack + music), 'script' (a host script makes the image), 'file' (copy the artifact). run.kind: 'process' (the exe), 'wine', 'script' (an emulator script, optional needs: 'bios'), 'adb'. devStream: how the development build streams profiler frames: 'cmake-log' (compile define), 'env-tcp' / 'env-log' (RENSGA_PROF_STREAM at run time), 'none'.

package.note: no BIOS inside; the emulator needs your own
